content.comment_body: Hello - We ([company_name]) are the largest college in Northern Ireland, and our plan is to acquire around 40 [product_name] units to lend to students for several weeks. We understand that the required [product_name] software must be purchased separately, such as on disc, which is acceptable. Our concern is whether, after the students return the devices, we can then provide the [product_name] and software to different students the following year. Will this create any issues? Specifically, could there be problems with software updates or functionality if it is installed on multiple devices over time? Any advice would be greatly appreciated. We have reached out to [company_name] contacts but have not yet received a response. [user_name]
Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. Please avoid posting multiple threads about the same issue. You have also opened a separate topic: Installing software on multiple devices
Thread closed due to duplicate question. The other thread titled Installing software on multiple devices is published in the [product_name] - Software section. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is requesting clarification regarding how software licenses for [product_name] should be managed when lending devices to students, specifically wondering whether the software can be reassigned and installed on different devices for new users each year, and if any technical or licensing issues may arise.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that the [product_name] software license will permit installation and use on multiple devices, allowing different users over time and without causing update or reinstallation restrictions.
